newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Main Colombian oil pipeline, Cano Limon field shut.
newsitem.headline: Main Colombian oil pipeline, Cano Limon field shut.

text.p: Production at the Occidental Petroleum Corp's Cano Limon field in eastern Colombia was still paralyzed Friday morning, a company official said.

Repair teams have been unable to reach the site where leftist rebels dynamited the country's main pipeline, for the second time in four days, leaving Occidental unable to pump crude from Cano Limon to the Caribbean coast lifting terminal at Covenas, a spokesman for the state-run oil company Ecopetrol said.
Occidental was forced to shut in the field early Thursday after scaling production back to 70,000 barrels per day from the daily average of 180,000 earlier in the week.

National Liberation Army (ELN) blasted the pipeline for the first time this week on Sunday near the town of Arauquita in eastern Arauca province. They dynamited it for the second time in the early hours Thursday just one hour after the initial break was repaired.
The Ecopetrol spokesman was unable to say when repair work on the pipeline would restart.
